description:
Stratyfix is an AI-driven sales intelligence platform. This plugin lets managers and reps ask about their own Stratyfix data in the chat they already use. Are we going to make the quarter? Who needs my attention this week? The answers come from the live platform.

Every person connects as themselves. A rep sees their own book and a manager sees their team, with the same permissions as the app itself. It is read only, so nothing in Stratyfix can be changed from chat. And it does not bluff. When Stratyfix withholds a number on purpose, because the odds are not calibrated yet or a target is not set, the plugin says exactly that instead of guessing.

You need a Stratyfix workspace, with the connector enabled by your administrator.

defaultPrompt: Which of our deals have a strategy brief today?
What's our chance of hitting this quarter's target?
Who should I coach this week, and why?
